summary: Novartis AG filed a Form 6-K press release announcing topline results from the pelacarsen Phase III Lp(a)HORIZON trial, which did not meet its primary endpoint of reducing cardiovascular events versus placebo in patients with elevated Lp(a) and established CVD. The study involved 8,323 participants. No deal terms, transactions, or special-situation corporate actions are present; this is a routine clinical data disclosure under a foreign private issuer report. The filing contains no securities-related event, and no specific risk-arb angle or M&A relevance applies.
